Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory and detailed condition assessments including building age, size, systems, and site features; uses multiple data sources and connects condition data to student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Sections 6, 7, 9, 10).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed 10-year enrollment projections with methodology, demographic analysis, capacity utilization by site and grade, and links projections to facility actions including new school construction and reconfiguration (Sections 4, 5, 9).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed discussion of how facilities support district mission, instructional priorities, and multiple programs including special education, early learning, and technology integration (Sections 1, 2, 9).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: District-wide data on outdoor spaces including shade, green surfaces, stormwater management; detailed site-specific greening strategies such as tree planting, permeable surfaces, outdoor classrooms, and climate resilience framing (Section 8).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Plan addresses climate impacts and resilience strategies in detail for multiple sites, including heat island mitigation, stormwater management, and natural ventilation; climate readiness is a theme but lacks comprehensive district-wide risk assessment for multiple climate impacts (Section 8).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Significant detail on energy use baselines, strategies for efficiency, electrification, decarbonization, and resilience including solar, battery storage, microgrids; references state requirements and integrates energy resilience with climate disruptions (Sections 8, 9).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, phased prioritization, multiple funding strategies including bonds and state grants, and long-term financial sustainability considerations; includes bond capacity analysis and implementation scenarios (Sections 9, 10).
